additional_info.subject: RE: Ticket 0473963 has been closed. Are you satisfied with our provided solution? CRM:00225326412
additional_info.body:
Hello,
It seems that you may need more context to understand the nature of the issue. However, I am not sure how to be clearer than in my previous email. To summarize :
During the commissioning of this charging station, the subcontractor technician present on site noticed that the door was not properly aligned. In other words, it is not perpendicular to the ground. As a result, the door protrudes into the area where the cover protecting the opening button is supposed to be placed or fixed, which prevents its installation.
The charging station had just been installed, so we assume it was delivered in this condition. The technician attempted to adjust the hinges in order to realign the door, but this was not possible.
Apart from this issue, the charging station is functional. However, we are unable to finalize the commissioning, as the door cannot be locked.
Could you please advise on the procedure to follow in this situation?
Kind regards,
Ramdane CHERGUI
